images.alt: Vergelijking: bomen zonder vrucht — Judas 1:12; tekstillustratie.
images.prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Photorealistic illustration of an explicit biblical comparison or event, first-century Roman Judea and Galilee, landscape 3:2, natural materials and daylight, anatomically coherent people with exactly two arms and animals with correct limbs; fully covering modest opaque robes. No modern objects, readable writing, portrait of God the Father, blood, injury or watermark. Jude 1:12 compares corrupt teachers to fruitless late-autumn trees, twice dead and uprooted. Photorealistic symbolic landscape of two leafless dead orchard trees toppled with exposed roots on dry ground under a restless autumn sky, no fruit on branches, no people or animals hurt. Restrained natural light, no faces in bark, supernatural monster or text. Clear botanical metaphor, distinct from the existing human study and mercy images.

images.alt: Vergelijking: wolken zonder water — Judas 1:12; tekstillustratie.
images.prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Photorealistic illustration of an explicit biblical comparison or event, first-century Roman Judea and Galilee, landscape 3:2, natural materials and daylight, anatomically coherent people with exactly two arms and animals with correct limbs; fully covering modest opaque robes. No modern objects, readable writing, portrait of God the Father, blood, injury or watermark. Jude 1:12 describes clouds without water carried along by the wind. Photorealistic symbolic landscape of fast-moving streaks of cloud crossing an ancient dry farmland sky, dusty parched soil below receiving no rain. No raindrops, lightning disaster, people in danger, modern structures or writing. Emphasize the promise of clouds but unwatered dry ground; metaphor illustration rather than a recorded drought event.
